freeze_note: Need-first Planner migration (owner decision 2026-10-10). Fast Work begins with ability_needs and the old indexed-lookup branch is gone, so every request was recaptured. Each recorded Fast output whose new request requires ability_needs declares every loaded Capability it uses as one fitting need (benchmarks.datasets.fast_planner_daily_life.qualification.declared_ability_needs); no search is triggered and plans are unchanged. Deep and evidence re-entry outputs, inputs, faults, provider outcomes, expectations and splits unchanged; every case still reaches its expected verdict; no candidate calls.
